rules.reason: Encode Latin letters and their diacritics consistently in UTF-8 NFC. Canonical composition preserves distinctions such as é and è used in the spelling guide.

evidence.locator: Balai Bahasa Yogyakarta, Pedoman Umum Ejaan Bahasa Jawa Huruf Latin yang Disempurnakan (2011), PDF page 9, printed p. 2, subsection B Huruf Vokal, paragraph below the vowel table (énak and èsem).
